channel.title: SSbusinessAndMarket
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: ‘I get more meetings because of the brand’: BlackBerry’s CEO on keeping a famous name
item.description: Also: All the news and watercooler chat from Fortune.

item.title: Spirit Halloween’s CEO says Trump’s tariffs were ‘going to put us out of business’—they even set up a war room. Then it had its best year ever
item.description: Spirit stopped ships, froze spending, and absorbed the tariff costs. Now its charity Spirit of Children is aiming for $20 million in its 20th year.

item.title: ‘The assertion that the AI is an autonomous being is insane’: Cyber expert says companies should face criminal charges when their AI hacks
item.description: From a decade-old PHP flaw to AI agents going off script, a wave of incidents this month shows how AI has handed attackers an edge.

item.title: Anthropic spent $2.75 million guarding Dario Amodei last year—more than 4 times his salary, but a fraction of Mark Zuckerberg’s security bill
item.description: Threats against AI executives jumped sevenfold this year. Anthropic’s IPO filing shows what it costs to keep its cofounders safe.
